name: io.github.kaiserunix/gemini-bastion-mcp
title: GeminiBastionMCP — Remote MCP Bastion for Web Gemini, Claude & ChatGPT
description: OAuth 2.1 MCP bastion for Web Gemini, Claude & ChatGPT: 10 tools, 1 gate, bwrap & multi-agent.

environmentVariables.name: PUBLIC_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Public HTTPS origin of your gateway (e.g. https://mcp.yourdomain.com)

environmentVariables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH
environmentVariables.description: Operator password hash in scrypt:<saltHex>:<keyHex> format

environmentVariables.name: OAUTH_SIGNING_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Random secret (>= 32 chars) used to sign OAuth tokens and admin sessions

environmentVariables.name: DEFAULT_AGENT_DRIVER
environmentVariables.description: Default autonomous coding agent driver (codex | claude_code | gemini_cli | opencode)

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional Google OAuth Client ID for upstream operator SSO on /admin/login and /oauth/authorize

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional GitHub OAuth Client ID for upstream operator SSO on /admin/login and /oauth/authorize
